description: 公共施設一覧(最新データ) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 飯塚市. 飯塚市内の公共施設の一覧です。 国の自治体標準オープンデータセットのフォーマットで公開しています。. Coverage: 飯塚市. The portal files it under the publisher 飯塚市. Its tags are 公共施設, 自治体標準ＯＤＳ. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
